messages:
tess: Trying the Node quickstart from the README. first call to client.chat.reply returns 403 but console shows I have a valid key. anyone seen this?

liam: can you paste the exact error and your package version?

tess: using @redwood/sdk v1.0.0, code:
```js
const Redwood = require('@redwood/sdk');
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
await client.chat.reply({ message: 'hi' });
```
error: 403 Forbidden { message: 'workspace billing required' }

devex-bot: Note: Org 'tess-team' has no billing profile. Add a billing method at https://console.redwood.ai/orgs/tess-team/billing to enable hosted API calls.

tess: weird, i thought the free trial auto-applies when you create the org via the console.

liam: that's the core issue. quickstart docs assume trial is present; in practice billing profile must be added for some orgs. also v1.0.0 had a bug where the client converted some 403 responses to a generic 401 when used inside long-running node processes.

ops: workaround: add billing profile, then restart your node process. the SDK caches an auth failure for 5 minutes on 1.0.0.

tess: i added billing and retried. curl to /v1/ping returned 200, but my app still throws 403 until i restart the server process.

liam: yep that's the cache. in 1.0.1 we changed behavior to not cache on 4xx and to surface the backend detail. can you try upgrading?

tess: upgraded to @redwood/sdk@1.0.1 and restarted server  now replies OK. thanks!

emma: I'll file two quick tasks: (1) update quickstart to explicitly mention adding a billing method if trial isn't present, (2) add a note about restarting long-running processes after fixing billing for older SDK versions.

devex-bot: Created ticket RDW-4823 (docs) and RDW-4824 (sdk) for follow-ups.

tess: super helpful. maybe also have the CLI/console show a more prominent "billing required" banner for new orgs so this is less hidden.

emma: agree, putting it on the onboarding flow. closing thread once tickets are in triage.
